project.title: Sedimentation dominates over diffusion in shaping riverine microbial biogeography: 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing of paired water-sediment samples from the Yellow River Basin
project.description: This project provides 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequencing data (V3-V4 region) from paired water column and riverbed sediment samples collected along six pollution gradients in the Yellow River Basin, Jiyuan City, Henan Province, China. Sampling was conducted in November 2023 at 78 synchronous water-sediment stations distributed across seven longitudinal positions per transect: one upstream reference site and six downstream positions at 0, 30, 100, 200, 500, and 1000 m from each discharge point. Pollution sources include urban sewage treatment plants, chemical companies, zinc and lead smelting facilities, and a steel factory. Sequencing was performed on the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform. This dataset was used to develop DiffusionSedModel, a fugacity-inspired deep learning framework integrating LSTM networks to quantify the relative contributions of vertical sedimentation and horizontal diffusion to microbial spatial organization across pollution gradients in a high-sediment river system.
